context: This criteria evaluates the correct configuration of TLS/SSL certificates for secure and authenticated connections.

checklist.name: CA certificate
checklist.description: Uses the .ca() method to set a custom Certificate Authority certificate for server validation

checklist.name: Client certificate
checklist.description: Uses the .cert() method to set the client certificate for mutual TLS authentication

checklist.name: Private key
checklist.description: Uses the .key() method to set the client private key that pairs with the certificate
